data.standardized_narrative: The available financial statements show the gross claims outstanding (closing 2014 comparative) at approximately 374.617 (thousand-units = $000), but the report does not present a clearly labelled, unambiguous GROSS prior-year movement figure in the scanned pages accessible. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' amount was reliably extractable from the provided images; therefore prior year development (gross) is not reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction from scanned images was incomplete. The Balance Sheet/Technical Provisions shows 'Claims outstanding' with a prior-year comparative of 374,617 (reported in $000) which was used for the opening reserves (converted to millions = 374.617). A clear, labelled GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was not located in the legible text/images; only claims triangles and various tables are present but not clearly reconciled to a single gross PY movement. Gross premium total was read as 240,488 ($000) from the statements. Many note tables are partially legible; I have therefore left prior-year development null rather than risk reporting a net figure or an incorrectly-read gross figure. Where values were uncertain I have left fields empty or null. If higher-resolution pages or the original PDF are provided I can extract precise movement, per-LOB movements and the claims development triangle amounts.
